purpose: Curated claim-level references for local retrieval; never use to estimate global or sample prevalence.
review_boundary: reference_verdict summarizes what a named external source supports/contradicts; NOT a VeriLoop-approved finding for any submitted video. All reviewed_by are null, and no reviews are seeded.
publication_date_policy: published_date is the source page publication date only where explicitly established; unknown set null, event or last-updated dates explained in notes.

records.claim_text: The clip shows Karachi mayor Murtaza Wahab falling into Gujjar Nala during a 2024 boat inspection.
records.notes: AFP traced the clip to a June 2016 capsize involving Panaji mayor Surendra Furtado in India. This reference concerns a specifically mislabeled repost, not the original footage or every channel discussing it.

records.claim_text: A total solar eclipse crossed Mexico, the United States and Canada on April 8, 2024.
records.notes: Event: April 8, 2024; North America. NASA describes the date and route. NASA page publication date is not established; event date is not a source publication date. Candidate B reference only.

records.claim_text: The nature or origin of specific unidentified anomalous phenomena has been scientifically established despite limited reliable observations.
records.notes: NASA says limited high-quality observations prevent firm scientific conclusions about UAP nature. This is an unresolved evidential question, not proof of any specific origin; do not label a video asserting or debunking an alien claim by mere similarity. Related independent study report released September 14, 2023.

records.claim_text: Specialized solar eye protection is required during the partial phases of a total solar eclipse.
records.notes: NASA explains safe viewing before/after totality, and the narrow totality exception. This is solar viewing guidance; do not use as evidence for unrelated astronomy headlines.

records.claim_text: Scientists can reliably predict the exact time, place and magnitude of a major earthquake in advance.
records.notes: USGS says scientifically reliable exact prediction of date/time, location and magnitude is not currently possible. Forecast probabilities and early warning are different concepts. USGS FAQ shows updated September 29, 2025, not confirmed original publication date.

records.claim_text: NASA Ingenuity helicopter made the first powered, controlled flight on another planet on April 19, 2021.
records.notes: NASA news release documents a powered controlled flight on Mars on April 19, 2021. Applies to Ingenuity first flight, not other Mars missions.

records.claim_text: A magnitude 9.1 earthquake struck near Tohoku, Japan, on March 11, 2011.
records.notes: USGS event entry describes March 11, 2011 near Honshu and magnitude 9.1; publication date for the continually updated event detail page not established. Note JMA historically reports 9.0 using its convention; do not equate magnitude catalog versions blindly.

records.claim_text: The 2024 Atlantic hurricane season had 18 named storms.
records.notes: NOAA seasonal report says 18 named storms and 5 major hurricanes in 2024. Original webpage publication date not independently confirmed from accessible article text. This is a seasonal count, not evidence that any given storm made landfall.

records.claim_text: 2024 was the warmest year on record in NASA global surface temperature analysis.
records.notes: NASA Earth Science report dated January 10, 2025; the finding is within NASA global surface temperature series, not necessarily every alternative dataset. 2024 remains record as reported in 2026 NASA context.
WHO Global Advisory Committee on Vaccine Safety states available high-quality evidence indicates vaccines do not cause autism. Represents source evidence, not a claim about any particular uploader.

records.claim_text: WHO estimated approximately 263 million malaria cases worldwide in 2023.
records.notes: 2024 WHO release reports estimated 263 million malaria cases in 2023. Modelled estimate, not a precise census or a current-year figure.

records.claim_text: WHO and UNICEF reported 127,350 measles cases in the WHO European Region for 2024.
records.notes: WHO/UNICEF reported 127350 European Region measles cases for calendar 2024; regional reporting figure is not worldwide incidence.

records.claim_text: COVID-19 mRNA vaccines alter recipients human DNA.
records.notes: WHO answer explicitly says mRNA vaccines have not been shown to integrate into recipients genes. No general guarantee about all possible future biologic products or unapproved therapies is implied.
